text:
nora: Quick hit from design review: run history + schema/tool-calling UX. Dropping short list of changes we can ship fast.

sam: go for it.

nora: 1) Collapse long schemas in run history. Show a one-line signature (e.g. `refund(amount: number)`) + chevron. Default collapsed to avoid perf and keyboard clutter.

yousef: +1. Chevron must be keyboard focusable and have aria-expanded + aria-controls.

mira: 2) Add a tiny copy signature action (hover/focus reveal). Accessible label `Copy function signature`. Fire a small aria-live toast "Signature copied".

nora: 3) Schema editor errors: replace "invalid schema" with actionable text using AJV error path and suggestion, e.g. `At required: expected array of property names; try ["amount"]`.

yousef: suggest an "Auto-fix" for trivial corrections (wrap in array). Always confirm before save.

a11y-bot: audit: mismatch badge contrast is 3.8:1; needs >=4.5:1 for small text. Also missing tabindex on expanded JSON block.

mira: 4) When tool output differs from schema show a compact key-level diff inline and offer `Save as new version` behind a confirm + changelog input. Keep default diff cheap (keys only).

sam: will mock collapsed row + diff side panel and include keyboard flow (focus on panel start, escape closes).

nora: thanks — if folks ok I'll turn into a short RFC and attach the mock.

yousef: fine by me.

mira: thanks all :sparkles:
